mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is a common misconception about the reactions of metals with water?

options.A: Only alkali metals react rapidly with cold water.
options.B: All metals react with water to liberate hydrogen gas.
options.C: Metals placed above hydrogen in the reactivity series can displace hydrogen from water.
options.D: Magnesium reacts slowly with hot water.

mcqs.answer: All metals react with water to liberate hydrogen gas.
mcqs.explanation: The statement in option B is false. Only metals that are above hydrogen in the reactivity series (such as alkali and some alkaline‑earth metals) react with water to produce hydrogen. Many metals like copper, iron and silver do not react with water under normal conditions. Options A, C and D are correct statements, so B is the misconception.

mcqs.question: When equal pieces of zinc and copper are separately added to dilute hydrochloric acid, which observation correctly explains the difference in their reactivity?

options.A: Zinc dissolves rapidly with evolution of hydrogen gas, while copper shows no visible reaction.
options.B: Both metals dissolve, but zinc evolution of hydrogen is accompanied by a noticeable rise in temperature.
options.C: Copper dissolves forming a blue solution of copper chloride, whereas zinc remains unchanged.
options.D: Both metals produce the same volume of hydrogen gas in the same time.

mcqs.answer: Zinc dissolves rapidly with evolution of hydrogen gas, while copper shows no visible reaction.
mcqs.explanation: Zinc is above hydrogen in the reactivity series, so it reacts with HCl to give ZnCl₂ and H₂ gas. Copper lies below hydrogen and does not react with dilute HCl, so no visible change occurs. Option B is incorrect because copper still does not react. Option C reverses the actual behaviour, and option D is false because only zinc produces hydrogen.

mcqs.question: Arrange the metals in order of decreasing ability to displace hydrogen from dilute acid: Mg, Fe, Zn, Cu.
mcqs.explanation: The reactivity series (most to least) is Mg, Zn, Fe, Cu. A metal’s ability to displace hydrogen follows this order, so magnesium displaces hydrogen most readily, followed by zinc, iron and finally copper, which does not displace hydrogen. Options B, C and D place the metals in an incorrect sequence.

mcqs.learning_point: Use the reactivity series to predict reactions
mcqs.question: Which of the following reactions will NOT occur spontaneously under standard conditions?
mcqs.explanation: Copper is less reactive than silver in the reactivity series, so it cannot displace silver ions from silver nitrate; the reaction is non‑spontaneous. The other reactions involve metals that are higher than hydrogen (Zn, Mg) or higher than the other metal (Fe above Cu), so they proceed spontaneously. Hence option D is the correct choice.
